Section 3 · Functional Genomics
Functional Annotation & Comparative Genomic Profiling
Comprehensive functional characterisation of 16 candidate novel ISS strains: COG annotation (Prokka), AMR/virulence/metal resistance (ABRicate — CARD, NCBI, VFDB, BacMet), biosynthetic gene clusters (antiSMASH), and mobilome analysis (geNomad — plasmids & bacteriophages).

108

10
AMR-Positive Strains
CARD + NCBI databases
COG Functional Category Distribution — Top 10 cumulative gene counts across 16 strains
Amino acid metabolism (E) and transcription (K) dominate — reflecting metabolic versatility and complex regulatory networks essential for ISS survival.
COG profile per strain — key functional categories
Grouped bars showing 11 COG categories per strain. Ralstonia strains show the broadest functional repertoire.
Average COG profile — ISS-relevant categories (radar)
Radar shows mean gene count per category across all 16 strains.
AMR & Resistance gene hits per strain — NCBI AMR · CARD · VFDB · BacMet (÷4 scaled)
Ralstonia houstonensis 121560039-2 carries OXA-573 (carbapenem) and OXA-574 (β-lactam). BacMet values scaled ÷4 for display.
CARD resistance class distribution
β-lactam/carbapenem resistance dominates (Ralstonia clade). Fluoroquinolone resistance detected in Staphylococci.
BacMet — metal & biocide resistance genes (≥80% identity)
Mercury resistance (mer operon) and chromate/heavy-metal efflux (chrA, cnrA, czcA) are most prevalent.
Complete AMR & resistance profile — all 16 strains (4 databases)

VFDB virulence gene details — Streptococcus houstonensis 151470009-6 (only positive strain)
StrainGeneProduct / function% Identity
BGC count per strain — antiSMASH (total 93 clusters across 16 strains)
NI-siderophore clusters are conserved across multiple genera, suggesting iron acquisition is a shared ISS-adaptive strategy.
BGC type distribution — all 93 clusters (polar area)
NI-siderophore (14), terpene (11), and betalactone (10) dominate.
High-confidence BGCs — ≥50% MIBiG similarity (12 clusters)
StrainBGC typeMost similar known clusterCategorySimilarity
Plasmid sequences per strain — geNomad
Ral. houstonensis 121560039-2 (17 plasmids) has the highest plasmid burden. Roth. houstonensis is the only plasmid-free strain.
Viral/prophage sequences per strain — geNomad
All 23 viral sequences are Caudoviricetes (dsDNA tailed phages). Staph. whitsoniae 121210007-3 carries 4 viral sequences.
Plasmid functional classification — AMR & conjugation marker prevalence
Of 108 plasmid sequences: 56 carry AMR marker genes and 35 carry conjugation genes.
Mobilome burden — plasmid vs viral sequences (bubble = plasmid count)
The Ralstonia clade (purple) dominates both axes. Strains in the top-right combine maximum genomic plasticity.
